parsed.explanation: Combined regime: state is in July 2026 Low-Risk group for adults, vetoed bathroom bills, and has patchwork service protections, so no documented local universal facility ban. But national layer remains operative for visitors: passport sex-marker restriction upheld Nov 2025, entry discrepancy can cause refusal and, if wilful misrepresentation found, permanent fraud ineligibility; government-facility binary order and custody harms are contested but unresolved. National threat framing and youth-targeting laws raise risk for families. Local protections do not cancel federal entry, facilities, or detention exposure.

entry_documents.exposure: Documented: X-marker processing stopped, existing X valid to expiry, new as M/F; entry cable requires refusal where discrepancy casts reasonable doubt on sex, and consideration of permanent fraud ineligibility for wilful misrepresentation. Passports confiscated/blocked reported.
entry_documents.protection: Fraud finding requires four elements, never automatic, limited waivers; existing X passports remain valid; policy challenged in court.
entry_documents.interaction: Local low-risk status does not override federal entry screening; discrepancy at entry can lead to refusal, investigation and detention exposure.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: Documented nationally: corrections bureau adopted conversion-therapy model including hair cutting, hormone removal; immigration custody reports of forced labour, beatings, solitary and severe sexual abuse of trans men.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: Several executive orders blocked/enjoined; no state-specific custody protection documented.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Entry fraud allegation could move visitor into federal detention where documented harms apply; state protections do not govern federal custody.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: National order barred trans people from government-funded single-sex facilities congruent with identity; many states ban facilities, 4 make use criminal in circumstances, one trespass arrest documented nationally.
federal_state_facilities.protection: This state vetoed bathroom bills in June 2023 and is in Low-Risk group; no state facility ban documented for this state. 29 states plus capital have no mapped ban.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: Federal facilities and any applicable federal rule remain under national regime despite state veto; status of blocked orders is uncertain.

care_services.exposure: National orders target gender-affirming care for minors; state bans surgery on transgender children from March 2023 and bars trans children from female sports; 1982 Medicaid surgery exclusion unresolved.
care_services.protection: June 2023 order gave state employees over 21 Medicaid gender-affirming coverage; county conversion-therapy ban and state funding ban documented.
care_services.interaction: Adult visitor emergency/prescribed care not documented as denied in this state; minor travelling with guardian faces documented youth-care and sports restrictions.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: National counterterrorism strategy prioritizes groups described as radically pro-transgender; justice guidance uses radical gender ideology framing; 66% poll support for birth-sex document laws.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: National hate-crime statute covers gender identity since 2009; 2020 employment ruling prohibits gender-identity discrimination; some orders enjoined.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Threat framing raises outing and enforcement risk at federal level, while state executive and municipal protections are patchwork with exemptions.

minors_guardians.exposure: Documented: state youth-targeting policies named in Low-Risk assessment, surgery ban for children, sports ban, hotline to report gender ideology, national orders to investigate schools and prosecute teachers facilitating social transition.
minors_guardians.protection: Governor vetoed bathroom/pronoun and safe-space bills; assessment judges youth policies unlikely extended to adults, not stated for minors travelling.
minors_guardians.interaction: Adult travelling with minor faces greater exposure than adult alone through care, school and sports rules; guardian status does not document immunity.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: No state-specific trans violence, arrest or detention incident documented; Pride organisation in second-largest city cancelled 2026 events and dissolved citing political/financial environment.
street_violence_police_response.protection: National hate-crime coverage; municipal ordinances in nine cities ban discrimination in employment, housing and public accommodations with exemptions.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: State hate-crime statute does not cover gender identity and gay/trans panic defence remains; absence of state incidents is not evidence of safety.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: Passport suit and challenges to 2025 orders unresolved; which measures in effect at travel unknown; Medicaid instrument interaction unresolved.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Civil-liberties suit, injunctions on several orders, legal-aid FAQ on documents documented.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Remedies are litigation-dependent and may change; local protections rest on executive orders and municipal ordinances vulnerable to change.

anchor_checks.comparison: Lower than 0.35-B? No, higher: that anchor has mandatory birth-sex hospital/detention placement with repeated harassment and no remedy. Here federal custody harms are documented but no mandatory birth-sex placement for this state is documented, and state vetoed bathroom bills, so exposure is less universal.

Similar to 0.55-E: recurring border humiliating questioning, partially disciplined/historically corrected, hotels/facilities generally serve, working tribunal in anchor vs patchwork protections and unresolved federal litigation here. No mandatory birth-sex search nationally established, keeping it at elevated rather than 0.45.

Lower than 0.75-C: that anchor has dead-letter sexuality law, accepted documents, ordinary court compensation enforced, and facilities by identity documented. Here federal entry discrepancy, passport restriction, threat framing and youth restrictions are operative or unresolved, so protections are weaker and less visitor-facing.

parsed.synthesis: Interaction dominates: state restraint and vetoes reduce local facility/service exposure for adults, but do not cancel federal entry document discrepancy, possible refusal/lifetime fraud consideration, federal facilities order uncertainty, or federal custody harms if detained. For adults alone this is uneven protection with serious border/custody tail risk; for a minor travelling with family, documented youth-care, sports and school-investigation rules add exposure. No state-specific violence pattern is documented, but national climate and patchwork remedies with exemptions, missing state hate-crime coverage, and retained panic defence leave recourse incomplete.
